name: Aviation Industry Corporation of China 612 Institute

evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as AVIC’s 612 Institute, also known as the China Airborne Missile Academy. AVIC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and says its businesses include aviation weapons and equipment and military transport aircraft. The US Commerce Department listed it in June 2023 for acquiring and attempting to acquire US-origin items in support of China’s military modernization, citing ties to activities including the design and manufacture of air-to-air missiles and hypersonic weapons development.
It belongs to AVIC, which describes itself as a very large state-owned enterprise managed by the central government.
